balls.text: run-out, full outside off, moved across to flick it past short fine, was rapped on the pads, they try to pinch a leg bye, Dinda picked it and flicked it onto the stumps at the non-striker's end to find Rayudu short
picked the gap beautifully, slower one, he picked it, took it off a length and dispatched it over extra cover
slow again, short on the off, he goes for the pull, misses and they pinch a quick single
slower one bowled on a good length outside off, swats it towards long-off for a single
shortish outside off, jabs at it, misses and they pick a quick bye
Ganguly takes a good catch at midwicket, that was bowled short and he slapped it just wide of him, Ganguly moved to his left, dived and held on
full outside off, cracked towards extra cover to retain stroke for a single
shortish on middle, moves away and swats it hard past the bowler to beat long-on to the boundary
low full toss, played down towards long-off for a single
slower one bowled short on middle, went across and tried to smack him over short fine leg, missed
shortish outside off, guided down towards third man for one more
angling it on middle, gets across and drives it him through midwicket for a couple, it went past Ganguly who, while diving, hurt himself a little but all is well now
lovely timing, flighted and bowled full outside off, he lofts it cleanly over long-off for a six, came off the meat
gone this time, short on the off, makes room and pulls it high, really high, and Kartik at long-on moves to his left and holds on to a well-judged catch
slaps it in ugly fashion over the bowler for a single
turns away again but a touch too wide this time, called
turning away, tries to play him past point, misses, the keeper goes up but the umpire turns him down, replays show there was an edge
short on the off, turning away and pulls it uppishly, it lands on the bounce in front of deep midwicket
full, made room and sliced it over point, Manoj Tiwary ran across, tumbled and saved a couple of runs
slower one bowled short outside off, he withdrew from the shot there, wasn't called a wide
four more, picked the slower one, was bowled on a length, made room and smashed it through extra cover
flicked away, was bowled full outside off, he moved across to clip it delightfully over midwicket for another four
slower one bowled short on middle, pushed towards midwicket for a single
shortish on the off, knocks it into the leg side for a quick single
nicely struck, came down the track and lofted it inside out over extra cover to beat long-off to the boundary, first boundary in more than 40 balls
flighted on the off, leans forward to drive it to long-off for a single
Mumbai are struggling here, flighted on the off, comes down the track and tries to loft it over the bowler's head, turns away, he misses and is stumped
chips it towards long-on for a single
almost holed out, fullish and he tried to clear long-off, got to Hussey on the bounce
waited for it to turn away, guided it just behind point for a quick single
pushed away through midwicket for a single
slow, at 116.8 kmph, short outside off, the batsman lets it go
slower one bowled short outside off, gets an under-edge while trying to guide it to third man, just the single
bowls it short from wide of the crease, pulled through square leg for a single
short of a good length on the off, defended towards extra cover
slower one bowled on a good length on the off, pushed towards mid-off for a single
flat into the pads, missed and rolled into the leg side for a single
came down the track and offered his pad, hid his bat behind it, they sneak a leg bye but shouldn't have been signalled one, there was no effort to play the shot, he just kicked it away
plays it in the direction of point for a quick single
fullish on middle, driven past the bowler to long-on for a single
tossed up from round the wicket, defended watchfully in front of extra cover
Kartik strikes, fullish on middle, Tiwary comes down the track and chips it straight to midwicket, his intention was to clear him but he could strike it well enough, a timely breakthrough for Kolkata
short of a good length outside off from round the wicket, tries to open the face and run that to third man, misses
timber! He's been bowling slower deliveries and that one was quicker, at 132 kmph, Duminy had been kept quiet and tried to dispatch that one over midwicket, missed and the stumps were splayed
shortish on the off, punched off the back foot wide of extra cover for a single
full on middle, driven hard along the pitch but straight onto the stumps at the non-striker's end
slower one bowled short outside off, guided down to third man for a single
short delivery on middle, pulled away over square leg for a single
three in a row, short of a length outside off, slower ball cutting away, he tries to slash that through point but can't get his bat to it
was late in picking that slower one as well, kept a little low and he tried to pull that over square leg, missed and got to the keeper on the third bounce
slower one, fooled Duminy there, cut away after pitching and Duminy had shaped up for the pull, missed
fires it on middle, pushed away between point and cover for a single
full toss on the off, driven through to long-off for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, cut away towards third man for a single
a bit of bounce there, defended in the off side in front of point, another quiet over
quick single, that turned sharply towards off from middle, he got a thick edge towards short third while trying to defend, picked a single
bowled it short on middle, defended to point
driven in the direction of long-off for a single
pushed off the front foot to extra cover again
tossed up on middle from round the wicket, defended to extra cover
comes down the track and turns it wide of midwicket for a single, a tidy over
flighted, bowled full outside off, drilled past Kartik for a single to long-off
gets front and across and tickles it in the direction of square leg
looks to chop it towards point, gets an inside edge on the bounce to the keeper
short, turning in, tries to nudge it behind point, misses
pushed off the front foot towards midwicket
pushes it back onto the pitch from the crease
short outside off again, reaches for it and cuts it towards deep point for a couple of runs
bowled quicker but short outside off, Tiwary cuts it hard in that gap between point and short third man, four more
eased off the front foot to deep cover for one more
fullish outside off, slapped towards deep cover for a single
is welcomed with a four, pitches it up and Tiwary leans forward to drive it crisply through extra cover
gave it plenty of air, Duminy tried to sweep it hard, missed and it turned in to just miss off
gets across and plays it just in front of midwicket
turning in, defends it in front of point for a quick single
turning in from a good length outside off, flatter, he gets outside the line to defend, is hit on the pads
a thick outside edge, that was bowled full outside off, tried to drive it through extra cover, caught the edge, beat point and raced to the ropes
tossed up on the off, slog-swept past midwicket and David Hussey does well in the deep, running across and diving to haul it back in
slower one on middle, drops it in front of point, an easy single on offer
fullish outside off, cracked hard but straight towards deep cover, just the single
low full toss on the off, pushed back firmly, the bowler gets a hand to it and deflects it to mid-off, quick single taken
slower one bowled short on the off, taps it towards point and steals a quick single
bowled it full on the off, driven towards mid-off and races through for a single
short of a good length on the off, knocks it down towards point
another slower ball, bowled full outside off this time and it's bludgeoned between mid-off and extra cover for a boundary
bowls it on a good length on the off, opens the face and guides it behind point
slower one dragged short, a Sourav Ganguly slower ball, gets back and pulls it with utter disdain over deep midwicket
pushed through to mid-off and he calls for a single and makes it in time, would have been interesting had there been a direct hit but replays show he was safe
bowled it on a good length on the off, driven through the line to mid-off
bowls it on a good length on middle, makes room and steers it to point for a quick single
slower one bowled shortish on the off, opens the face and guides it to point
slower one this time but doesn't get his direction right, tucked away behind square again, they get a couple this time
can't stray on the pads with the fine leg up, Duminy walks across and flicks it elegantly past that fielder to the boundary
well run, drops it down in the off side and sets off for a quick single
gets back again and taps it towards cover
short of a good length on middle, gets back and pushes it back to the bowler
pushed it on the leg side, whipped through towards deep midwicket for a single
slower one bowled short on the off, pushed in front of cover
short on middle, poor ball, pulls it away behind short fine for a boundary
appeared to keep a touch low there, shortish on the off, pushes it back to the bowler
slides it down the leg side, tries to clip it fine, misses, called a wide
short of a good length on middle, gets back and knocks it down to the bowler
straying on the pads, tickles it behind square for a couple of runs in the deep
short of a good length on the off, gets on the back foot to defend, gets an inside edge onto his pads

the short delivery does him in, banged it in outside off, Dhawan waited for it and tried to guide it over the keeper but could not get the elevation, went off the face and into Saha's hands, the openers have been sent back quickly
short outside off, cuts it down to third man for a single
angling it away from the left hander, slower one, Dhawan gets across and guides it down to third man
lovely timing, overpitched on the off, driven through the line past the bowler and mid-off for a boundary
bowls it at 141.7 kmph, on leg stump, pushed away just wide of mid-on for a single
short of a length on middle, they've tried this a few times today and failed, tries to force it through the leg side, gets an inside edge onto the pads
shortish on middle, worked away behind square, behind short fine, for a couple of runs
short of a good length on middle, gets front and across to punch it through midwicket, misses and it clips the thighs on the way to the keeper
shortish on leg stump, pushed in the direction of midwicket
shortish on leg stump, tries to whip it through square, is struck on the thighs and it drops on the off side, they race through for a single
short of a good length on the off, knocks it down in front of cover
pushed in front of mid-on for a quick single

for a while that looked like an upper cut, at least that's what he tried to do, but he ends up getting that short delivery on the toe end of the bat and skies it in front of square, Murali Kartik gets under it and just about manages to hold on after juggling a couple of times
short of a good length on the off, nips back in a hint, defended in the direction of cover
short of a good length on middle, worked towards square leg for a quick single
short of a good length on middle, tries to whip it through the leg side, is struck on the ribs and it drops on the pitch
short of a good length on the off, drops it on the off side from the crease and races off for a single
all over, short outside off, moves across and pulls it hard over midwicket for a boundary to seal a thumping win
short of a good length on middle, whips it through square leg for a single
pulled away towards deep square leg for a single
flicked away towards deep midwicket, they have enough time to head back for the second
flighted on middle, comes down the track, lands full, and is smashed on the bounce to long-off
fires it hard down the leg side, the keeper fails to hold on and the result is five wides, Kolkata are inching closer
quicker delivery on the off, gets on the back foot and pushes it to point
turns away a hint, comes down the track and he ends up slicing it over cover
eased wide of point for a single
short of a good length on middle, turns away, pushed away off the back foot to the bowler
bowled on a good length outside off, chips it towards long-on on the bounce
brings up his half-century, full toss on the off, punched through to deep cover for a single
slower one bowled full, pushed down the ground to long-on for a single
shot! Seized on the length early, short on the off, stands tall and pulls him away over deep midwicket for a big six
angling in towards leg stump, tries to flick it behind square, strikes him on the pads, they get a leg bye
slower one bowled short outside off, cuts back in, catches him on the glove, drops it on the off side and races through for a single
short on leg and turns towards middle, gets on the back foot and pushes it wide of midwicket for a single
finds the gap, fullish outside off, smashed hard over extra cover to beat that gap between long-off and deep extra cover
lands on a good length outside off, comes down the track and smacks it down towards long-on
short of a length, gets on the back foot and punches it to deep cover
shortish, gets on the back foot and drops it into the leg side
fullish on the off, chipped in the direction of extra cover
flicked behind square leg for a couple of runs
wide down the leg side, slower one again

Bravo and McLaren almost got into a collision there, I don't think anyone called, the slower one there and Ganguly tried to smash that over midwicket, was early into the shot and got the leading edge towards extra cover, both fielders went for it, Bravo got to it first, the ball popped out and he he held on to the second attempt
and again, gets it behind the keeper and Ganguly calls for the single
slower one bowled short on middle, goes for the pull, gets an inside edge onto the pads
fullish on middle,. yorker length, dug out towards extra cover
slower one bowled short, McCullum makes room and cuts him in the vacant off-side field outside the circle for a boundary
short of a length outside off, cut away towards deep point for a single
slower one bowled short outside off, the legcutter there, was too wide, McCullum didn't get to it
slower one bowled short outside off, tries to pull it hard past midwicket, makes no contact
slower one bowled short, charges down and mistimes it back to the bowler
full toss outside off, comes down the track and slashes it over point for a boundary

a vicious beamer by Fernando, McCullum came down the track and it was heading towards his head, he reacted quickly to duck and get out of the way, and in compensation, won five no-balls as the keeper missed it
short on the off, slaps it hard wide of long-on for a couple of runs
slower one bowled full, wants to dispatch it over long-on but misses
driven into the off side
pushed towards mid-off for a single
and again, misses but his struck high on the pads, would have hit the stumps however, appeared to have been struck in line, the umpire doesn't think so, the appeal is turned dow
slower one bowled short, goes for the slog-sweep, strikes him on the chest
slower one bowled full outside leg, tries ti work it into the leg side, misses, strikes him on the pads, Ganguly says its bat and the umpire believes him even when there was no contact
slower ball bowled short on middle, pulled hard to backward square leg
smashed but on the bounce to long-off, full and he charged down the track, connected well but not in the gap
short of a good length, cuts it through point in the deep for a single
slower one bowled full on middle, swept away towards deep square leg
gets across and tries to flick it through square leg, is struck high on the pads
short of a good length outside off, chopped it to point, missed run-out  as McCullum had almost made his way to the striker's end with no response, the throw was to the wrong end
full on middle and leg, swept it down to short fine leg
pushed off the back foot through midwicket for a single
lands outside leg and turns towards middle, drops it in the off side
almost identical, fullish on middle, makes plenty of room and has no difficulty dispatching it in that gap between long-off and deep extra cover
shortish on the off, guided towards point
Ganguly continues his merry way, that was flighted outside off, makes room and lofted it over extra cover
short of a good length on the off, punches it off the back foot to long-on
comes down the track and drives it to long-on for a single
tossed up on the off, defended towards extra cover
worked away off the back foot wide of midwicket for a single
played it back to the bowler on the front foot
short on the off, turning in, pushed towards extra cover
fires it hard down the leg side, McCullum helps it on its way to the fine-leg boundary
fullish on the off, pushed back to the bowler
appeal for run-out, pushed into the off side towards extra cover, a direct hit onto the non-striker's end, Ganguly has just made it in
shortish on leg stump, makes room and slaps it to point
worked off the front foot wide of square leg
flighted outside off, pushed towards deep extra cover
slower one bowled full on the off, driven through to long-off for a single
full toss, a low one on the off, driven to long-off for a single
short of a good length on the off, punched towards cover for a single
slower one outside off, slaps it towards deep extra cover for a single
the McCullum slog-sweep, not quite the right length but he backed himself there, bent low and smashed him over midwicket
lands on a good length on leg stump, pushed through midwicket for a single
an attempt at a paddle scoop gone bad, full on middle, tried to get it over short fine, gets the toe end of the bat and lobs up in front of midwicket, falls short
dropped, McLaren spills that one, bowled full outside off, it's drilled hard towards extra cover where he fails to hold on
short on the off, pulled away hard to deep square leg for a single
fullish on middle, plays it back gently to the bowler
slower one bowled full on middle, turned away towards midwicket
bowled short outside off, tries to pull it behind square, can't connect, a wide signalled
slower one bowled on leg stump, worked towards short fine leg
third man is up and Ganguly dismisses that with ease, it's bowled short outside off, makes room and slashes him over point for a one bounce four
pushes it off the front foot to mid-on for a single
errs in length and McCullum dispatches it, making room and cutting it hard through point to beat third man

shortish on middle, pushed it towards extra cover and sneaked a single, a needless throw to the striker's end by Bravo, misses and concedes an extra run as Dilhara runs back and backs that up superbly
bowls it full outside off, swings it on the bounce to mid-on
angles it in towards middle, McCullum comes down the track and pushes him to cover
short of a good length outside off, makes room to guide him to third man, misses
beautifully timed, short again, he used the depth of the crease to move back and just punched it over mid-off, it sailed over the ropes, lovely shot
short of a length outside off, makes room and slaps him hard over extra cover for a boundary
bowls it on a good length outside off, tries to smash it over the bowler's head, mistimes it, gets a single to mid-on
full outside off, almost yorker length, dug out behind point for a single
hurled it short on middle, mistimes a pull towards midwicket
short of a good length on the off, chops it towards point
down the leg side, McCullum tries to swipe that over short fine, misses and its called a wide

what happened there? Binny lost it I think, full toss on the off, comes down the track and smacks that hard past mid-off where Binny was motionless, he could have moved to his right but appeared to be caught by surprise
bowls it short on the off, gets on the back foot and defends it onto the off side
angles it full on middle, flicks it towards short fine leg
short of a length on the off, cut away to point
slides it on the pads, tries to flick it fine, clips the pads and they get a leg bye
short of a length outside off, cut away to point
shot! Full outside off, driven through the covers, came off the meat, nicely timed, gets a boundary
bouncer, banged in short on middle and McCullum ducks under it
short of a length on leg stump, fends it away towards square leg for a single
fullish on middle, driven wide of mid-on for a single
short of a length on the off, tries to drop it into the off side, gets an inside edge onto his pads
short of a good length outside off, pushed back to the bowler from the crease
bowled it short outside off, kept a little low, made room to cut, missed
gets forward and dabs that shortish delivery to short third man
short on the off, a long hop, rocks back and pulls him miles over midwicket for a big six
short outside off, mistimes a punch towards extra cover
short outside off, cut away off the back foot to point
